_comment: dithered-shadow-test-sampling task 5.5: reachability/regression baseline for PCF_KERNEL_SIZE == 1, unreachable through the runtime UI (combo box only offers 2/3/5/7) or any other smoke gate. Copy of startup_config_pcf_kernel_size_a.json with render.pcfKernelSize=1 and FanBladeA/FanBladeB's spinSpeed removed (this fixture's blades are static -- _a's wall-clock-driven spin would be a flaky, non-reproducible baseline since smoke_run_one pins no SMOKE_OBJECT_SPIN, and motion is irrelevant to a kernel-1 reachability check; the actual motion/dithering visual check uses _a directly, see task 5.6). Spot light widened (innerConeAngle 20->40, outerConeAngle 34->75, range 30->60, intensity 18->30) relative to _a: _a's narrow spotlight-in-a-void framing leaves 4 of smoke_hash_status's 5 fixed-UV canary samples (bottom-right/bottom-center/top/mid-left) landing outside the lit disc, tripping its DEAD_CANARIES heuristic on an otherwise-correct render -- discovered running this gate for the first time. Widening the cone lights enough of the floor plane to clear the canary check while keeping the same rig/objects/kernel size. Camera position.x also nudged 0->6.0: the unmodified camera looks straight down the fan's own axis, landing the crossed-blade shadow exactly on the center canary (0.5,0.5) -- a second legitimate but coincidental black sample alongside the sky-void top canary, still tripping the >=2-dead-canaries heuristic. Shifting the camera sideways keeps the same fan/floor/light rig in frame while moving the shadow cross off the exact center pixel.
